shortDescription: Create one or more VMs based on a FortiFlex Configuration.

options.name: configId
options.description: The ID of a FortiFlex Configuration.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of VM(s) to be created. The default value is 1.

options.name: endDate
options.description: VM(s) end date. It can not be before today's date or after the program's end date. Any format that satisfies [ISO 8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime-970915.html) is accepted. Recommended format is "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss". If not specify, it will use the program's end date automatically.

options.name: folderPath
options.description: The folder path of the VM(s).

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_PASSWORD.

options.name: skipPending
options.description: Set it to true will activate the entitlement right away and charges start to incur even without downloading the license by token.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_USERNAME.
